{{Quote|Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome aboard the pleasure yacht ''Arleen'', now in interstellar transit from Antipose IX to&mdash;|A pilot droid|<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
The '''Antipose system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Antipose]] and [[Antipose XII]] as well as the celestial body [[Antipose IX]]. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the pleasure [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Arleen]]'' was making [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long tours from the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] to the Antipose [[Star system/Legends|system]].

The former [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] became the ruler of Antipose at some point by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], organizing a system of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions on the planet with a valuable [[power gem]] as the ultimate prize. That year, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Antipose in search of a power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]]. Solo ultimately convinced Raskar to declare Chewbacca the winner of the contests and hand over the artifact, after which Raskar eventually returned to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]].

==Description==
The Antipose [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Falko Run]] linked it to the [[Falko system/Legends|Falko]] and [[Paulking system/Legends|Paulking systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system contained a [[Antipose system star|star]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Antipose]]<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> and [[Antipose XII]] as well as the celestial body [[Antipose IX]].<ref name="Gamer5" /> The Antipose system's orbital bodies included a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-colored astronomical object and a celestial body that appeared large and dark blue from the surface of Antipose.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==History==
===Gladiators and cruises===
{{Quote|Instead of ruling a modest planet as when you met me&hellip; I'm reduced to being a ''pirate'' again!|Raskar, to Han Solo|<ref name="ANewBeginning">"[[A New Beginning]]"</ref>}}
[[File:RaskarPowerGem-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Raskar set up a gladiatorial contest system on Antipose with his power gem as the ultimate prize.]]
Following the [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|destruction]] of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_1.html|Jedi Smash Iridium Pirates; 3 Knights Killed}}, which is presented as a contemporary [[in-universe]] account of the [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|destruction]] of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]], is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the member of the group [[Raskar]] retired from [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] with a [[power gem]]<ref name="PowerGem" />&mdash;a rare artifact composed of a<ref name="CSWE power">{{CSWECite|III|40|power gem}}</ref> [[Meteorite/Legends|meteoritic]]<ref name="DoomMission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]<ref name="CSWE power" />&mdash;in his possession. Raskar settled on Antipose,<ref name="PowerGem" /> becoming its ruler in the process,<ref name="ANewBeginning" /> and organized a system of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions with the power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] as the prize for the ultimate winner. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], many individuals sought to participate in the gladiatorial fights.<ref name="PowerGem" />

The pleasure [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Arleen]]'',<ref name="Gamer5" /> which existed<ref name="LCMS" /> by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[The Lando Calrissian Adventures (omnibus)|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel trilogy, of which ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' is the first installment, between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> was making [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long tours from the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] to Antipose IX and Antipose XII.<ref name="Gamer5" /> At some point between 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] rented a [[Unidentified pilot droid (Oseon 2795)|pilot droid]] to help him travel in his starship, the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oseon 2795]] to the planet [[Rafa IV]] in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]]. Once the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] arrived at its destination, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] addressed a non-existent audience as if it was aboard the ''Arleen'' instead and claimed&mdash;to the annoyance of Calrissian&mdash;that the vessel was undergoing an [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] voyage from Antipose IX.<ref name="LCMS" />

===The end of the contest===
{{Quote|Your little drinking buddy thinks he ''saw'' one on this ''rimworld'' we're headed for&hellip;?|Han Solo, discussing power gems with Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:RaskarMystraSoloPowerGem-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Han Solo (right) convinced Raskar to hand over the power gem to him and Chewbacca.]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], therefore placing it in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who by that time owned the ''Millennium Falcon'', was tasked by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] with finding and obtaining a power gem in order to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] combat the new<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="SSDDatabank">{{DB|starship|superstardestroyer|Super Star Destroyer}}</ref> Aboard the<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Junkfort">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Junkfort system]]</ref> [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]], an [[Raskar's agent|alien]]&mdash;who, unbeknownst to Solo and his copilot, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], was an agent for Raskar&mdash;pointed the pair to Antipose, claiming he had seen a power gem there.<ref name="PowerGem" />

Solo and Chewbacca then traveled to Antipose, where Solo eventually convinced Raskar to declare Chewbacca the ultimate winner of the gladiatorial contest. The smuggler pair then departed Antipose aboard the ''Falcon'',<ref name="PowerGem" /> returning to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance base]] on<ref name="Iceworld">"[[Iceworld]]"</ref> the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" /> Raskar, on the other hand, eventually experienced financial difficulties and was forced to return to interstellar piracy.<ref name="ANewBeginning" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Mystra, you've got jokers ''paying'' for the chance to get their ''heads'' busted in that arena?|Han Solo|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
By 0 ABY,<ref name="0 ABY" /> the only [[Antipose city|city]] on Antipose was inhabited by [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking members of various [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="PowerGem" /> Antipose XII was sparsely populated.<ref name="Gamer5" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:A_Campaign_Guide_to_the_Centrality_G5.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The first unambiguously canonical mention of the Antipose system in ''Star Wars'' Legends was in the article "A Campaign Guide to the Centrality."]]
The Antipose system<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>&mdash;the name of which was based on mentions of Antipose IX<ref name="LCMS" /> and Antipose XII in earlier ''[[Star Wars]]'' source material<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>&mdash;was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article that was published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine and placed the system in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle" /> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The system's first canonical mention was in the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]," authored by [[Michael Kogge]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer5" /> on [[July 24]], [[2001]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010627.html|text=''Gamer'' #5. A Domain of Evil it is.}}</ref>

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]], created an apparent contradiction by stating that the Antipose system was situated "not far from Centrality,"<ref name="CSWE Antipose">{{CSWECite|I|36|Antipose}}</ref> despite "A Campaign Guide to the Centrality" establishing that the system indeed constituted a part of that sector.<ref name="Gamer5" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently overrode both the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement and information from ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' by placing the Antipose system in grid square U-8 as part of the Centrality.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> one of the co-authors of ''The Essential Atlas'',<ref name="TEA" /> later established in his [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]] on [[StarWars.com]] that the location name "Antipose" mentioned in the book also referred to<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> the unnamed planet that appeared in "[[The Power Gem]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Archie Goodwin]], penciled by [[Al Williamson]], and published between [[July 26]] and [[October 3]], [[1982]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref> Thus, the Antipose system was [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established to have first appeared in "The Power Gem."<ref name="UnstatedCanon" />
